name: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 - Cebu
short_description: A half-marathon event in Mandaue, Philippines, held on August 2, 2026, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 - Cebu is scheduled for August 2, 2026, at Ayala Malls Gatewalk in Mandaue, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series brand, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, with the half marathon as the primary distance. Registration details have not yet been announced.

core_facts.organizer: Runrio (brand: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series)

pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit a range of runner abilities
Organized by Runrio, an established name behind the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series
Convenient venue at Ayala Malls Gatewalk, a well-known Mandaue landmark
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
No pricing, route, or cut-off time information currently provided
research_highlights: The Cebu leg is part of a new nationwide six-city series (Manila, Davao, Cebu, Cagayan de Oro, Iloilo, Clark) now in its second year, launched by PUMA Philippines and RUNRIO Inc.
Runners can choose from 5K, 10K, and 21K distances at the Cebu leg, held at Ayala Malls Gatewalk in Mandaue, Cebu on August 2, 2026.
Finishing all six legs of the 21K category across the series earns runners an exclusive All-City Finisher Medal.
Top 3 finishers in each age group (Male/Female) in the 21K category are recognized at an on-site awarding ceremony, and winners must be present to claim their award.

The 2025 Cebu edition (a related prior RUNRIO Cebu half marathon) was held at City di Mare / Il Corso Skywalk on Cebu's South Coastal Road, indicating RUNRIO has used both South Coastal Road and Mandaue-area venues for its Cebu races in recent years.
research_watchouts: Entry fees are non-refundable and registrations cannot be transferred to another participant or deferred to a future edition.

Participants who do not start within 15 minutes of their category's flag-off time are disqualified and will not receive race results, per RUNRIO's standard race mechanics used in the 2025 Cebu edition.
There is no on-site registration on race day — only pre-registered runners with claimed kits (or unclaimed kits picked up on-site) can participate.

No independent participant race reports, course reviews, or first-hand runner feedback (e.g., on heat, crowd support, or organization quality) for this specific event were found in public search results at this time.

faqs.question: When is the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 - Cebu taking place?
faqs.answer: This race is scheduled to take place on August 2, 2026. It will be held at Ayala Malls Gatewalk in Mandaue, Philippines. No further schedule details, such as specific start times for each distance category, have been provided in the available information at this time.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: 21.1km (half marathon), 10km, and 5km. The half marathon distance of 21.1km serves as the primary distance for this event, which is part of the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series held in Cebu.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: This race is organized by Runrio, operating under the brand name PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series. Runrio is responsible for coordinating this event, which takes place in Mandaue, Philippines, as part of a broader series of half marathon events branded under PUMA across the Philippines.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: According to the available information, the registration status for this race has not yet been announced. Prospective participants interested in the 21.1km, 10km, or 5km distances will need to wait for official registration details to be released by the organizer, Runrio, closer to the event date.
